sloka: अग्निहोत्रं व्रजत्वग्रे दीप्यमानं सह द्विजैः ।वाजपेयातपत्रं च शोभमानं महापथे ।। ७.१०९.२ ॥
transliteration: agnihotraṁ vrajatvagre dīpyamānaṁ saha dvijaiḥ ।vājapeyātapatraṁ ca śobhamānaṁ mahāpathe ।। 7.109.2 ॥

translations.english: He instructed that the shining sacred fire should go in front with the Brahmins, and the splendid Vajapeya umbrella should also be carried on the great path.
